user.title: Add kiosk device
user.description:
Enter settings for this kiosk device.

What to enter:
• Device Identifier: A unique id used in the command/settings URL path (example: ipad_study).
• Display Name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant.
• Device Access Token: Optional token the kiosk app sends when polling.
• Rotation website URLs: Enter one URL per line (commas also accepted).
• Rotation Interval (seconds): Time between website changes.
• Start URL: Optional URL used by the Load Start URL action.
• Screen-Off URL: Optional URL shown when Tablet Screen is turned off.

data_description.device_id: Unique ID used in the command/settings endpoint URL for this kiosk.

data_description.websites: Enter one URL per line (commas are also accepted).
data_description.rotate_frequency_seconds: How often to rotate to the next website.
data_description.start_url: URL loaded when the Load Start URL action is triggered.
data_description.screen_off_url: URL displayed when the Tablet Screen switch is turned off.
